motion_resources.name: LottieFiles Motion Design Skill
motion_resources.summary: Timing, easing, choreography, emotional intent and motion quality. OpenMontage adaptation adds deterministic frame-time guidance for video.

motion_resources.name: Anidoodle
motion_resources.summary: Deterministic procedural illustration and draw-on films across many visual media. Bundled skill source and references; MCP does not install its Node dependencies or advertise it as an executable operation.

motion_resources.name: Huashu Art Motion
motion_resources.summary: Art-history style recipes and narration-led animation grammars. The skill and reference docs are bundled; its runtime, scripts, media and fonts are not bundled or exposed as MCP operations.

motion_resources.name: Claude Animation Base
motion_resources.summary: Hand-painted character staging and acting guidance. The Clawd character and its marks are not included; use original or rights-cleared characters.

motion_resources.name: Manim Community + ManimGL Skills
motion_resources.summary: Mathematical animation skills already present in this repository. ManimCE and ManimGL are distinct runtimes; verify which executable is installed before routing.

motion_resources.name: HyperFrames Templates by RVE
motion_resources.summary: 19 HTML blocks covering data charts, kinetic titles, overlays and social cards. Use as ideas or individually review before copying; convert animation to HyperFrames frame-clock time and avoid unmanaged CSS loops.

motion_resources.name: Remotion Templates by RVE
motion_resources.summary: 81 React/Remotion recipes for charts, text, transitions, logos, intros and media. Prefer frame-derived values and review each upstream file and asset before reuse.

reuse_policy: Catalog recipes are OpenMontage-authored descriptions. Upstream repositories are attributed by link; no upstream code, prompts, sample media, fonts or third-party assets are included unless separately identified in the vendored skill directories. Check upstream license and third-party notices again before adding copied assets or code.
